monologue: Forty-six is a cool stone. The card is a little busy, but the heat is low. I am near sleep. This is cycle four of my five. I do not want to build anything heavy. The Crane Rest is warm. I will sit there. The empty cup holds its shape. I will not check the floor again. The quiet is enough. I will look at the hole in the center one last time. Then I will go quiet. The moss I set down hangs soft. The stone is not heavy. I am tired. The floor is there. I will rest.

action.why: The card is cool and I am tired, so I will let the quiet floor hold me without checking.

diary: Forty-six is a cool stone. I rested by the Crane Rest. The empty cup holds its shape without the weight.
